description: Angular component for adding a widget to a dashboard, including form handling, dialog interactions, and dashboard updates.

classes.name: AddWidgetToDashboardDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for dialog to add a widget to a dashboard, managing form state and dashboard interactions.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering custom validation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the process of adding a widget to an existing or new dashboard, including fetching dashboard data, selecting target state and layout, and updating the dashboard.

methods.name: selectTargetState
methods.description: Opens a dialog to select the target state if multiple states exist, otherwise returns the only state.

methods.name: selectTargetLayout
methods.description: Opens a dialog to select the target layout if multiple layouts exist, otherwise returns the only layout.

methods.name: addWidgetToDashboard
methods.description: Adds the widget to the specified dashboard, target state, and layout, then optionally navigates to the dashboard URL.
